reason: My biggest fear is losing everything if this one phone dies, and online backup plus downloading my data any time fixes that; ₹5,000 down with the second half only if my stylists actually use it is a small risk for a salon my size. The cash-drawer and cancelled-bill checks are what I really want, I can't watch every chair myself.
objection: My stylists live on WhatsApp and are not comfortable in English; if they find a new app slower than writing in the register, they will stop using it after a week and I am back to WhatsApp, with my customer list split in two places.
would_change_my_mind: If the person who sets it up stops answering on WhatsApp during Durga Puja or wedding season when the salon is full, I would cancel.
